entities.name: Jean Anthelme Brillat-Savarin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean Anthelme Brillat-Savarin was a French lawyer and politician, who, as the author of Physiologie du goût, became celebrated for his culinary reminiscences and reflections on the craft and science of cookery and the art of eating.
